elements.element: Frequency limited to no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "will be conducted no more than once in any 12 month period"

elements.element: At least 30 days' prior written notice
elements.evidence: "upon at least 30 days' prior written notice to Customer"

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "at IBM's cost unless the investigation reveals an underpayment by Customer exceeding 5%"

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems

elements.evidence: "no more than once in any 12 month period"
30 days' notice exceeds the 15-day fallback minimum

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "at IBM's cost unless ... underpayment ... exceeding 5%" (stricter than fallback)

reasons: All seven atomic preferred elements are expressly stated in the single inserted sentence; the preferred level is complete.
The insertion is a concise addition to a clause that previously contained no audit/investigation limits, which is an appropriate approach.
Minimality fails only on the added phrase "off-site where possible", which is not required by either the preferred or fallback position and adds a new (vague) location mechanic beyond what is needed.
No unrelated commercial term is disturbed: the original three paragraphs of § 11.3 remain fully effective and no undefined term or contradiction is introduced.
